source_note: GDOS's national pomniki przyrody register (poland-gdos-pomniki-przyrody.json, CC0) gives coordinates, designation date and species only, no name, age or girth. Polish Wikipedia's 'Pomniki przyrody w Krakowie' article reproduces the city's own official registry list ('wykaz'), including street address, girth in cm and designation year per tree, joined here to the GDOS entries by their shared INSPIRE code. This is the same join used to verify the six trees delivered this pass (kra_005 to kra_010).

leads.name: The Wadow Park Silver Linden
leads.reason: Coordinates now resolved via the GDOS register join: Park Wadow sits in Wzgorza Krzeslawickie, roughly 14 km from the centre by straight line (Nominatim confirms the park itself, place_id 425489551, in the Glinik/Wadow area of that district). That is well past this project's day-trip boundary (~30 min transit of the centre) on distance alone, and this pass did not have time to check whether a fast direct bus/tram route could still bring it inside 30 minutes; until someone checks a real transit time, treat this as likely too far rather than confirmed too far. The rest of the cluster (elm 463cm, two oaks 340/353cm, a small-leaved lime with no girth recorded) sits within about 100m of this tree, same designation batch (2017-12-29), same source. If a transit check clears it, this is a strong second Krakow walk: the 559cm girth here would be larger than every tree currently published for this city.
leads.status: unresolved, transit time to centre needs checking before this can ship

leads.name: French Maple on ul. [unnamed nearby street]
leads.reason: 0.54 km from centre, 454 m from any published tree; a genuinely rare species for a Krakow street tree, which would have made a strong, distinctive addition. Not pursued this pass: designated only weeks before this pass (2026-06-06), too recent to appear in the 2023-snapshot Wikipedia wykaz table used to cross-source this city's other trees, so no second independent source (address, girth, or photo) could be found in the time available. GDOS alone is one source. Re-checked this pass (2026-08-28): still absent from the wykaz table, which tops out at entry 362 (2023 batch). Worth a dedicated look once a 2026 update to the city's own wykaz or a local news item about the new designation surfaces.

leads.name: Cluster of exotic monuments in the Botanical Garden area (Ogród Botaniczny UJ vicinity)
leads.species: Hungarian Oak (Quercus frainetto), Canary Island Date Palm (Phoenix canariensis), Sago Palm (Cycas circinalis), a second Ginkgo biloba, and others
leads.reason: [RESOLVED 2026-08-30: all confirmed inside the Botanical Garden (ul. Kopernika 27), joined via the Wikipedia wykaz table's own address field, not street trees. Hungarian Oak and Canary Palm and Cycas circinalis delivered as kra_032/033/034 (verified pass, data/research/krakow-verified.json); the second Ginkgo (CRFOP .2842, girth 281cm) left as a lead rather than shipped, since Krakow already carries three published ginkgos and this pass judged the palm and cycad the stronger, more distinctive additions from the same garden. Stangeria dziwna (CRFOP .2843, 'kłodzina w całości pod ziemią', an underground stem) also left as a lead: not a collectible above-ground point.]
leads.status: partially resolved; Ginkgo (CRFOP .2842) and Stangeria dziwna (CRFOP .2843) remain open leads

leads.name: Debniki elm/oak/maple micro-cluster near ul. Baluckiego
leads.species: Pedunculate Elm / European White Elm (Ulmus laevis, seven separately-designated specimens), Pedunculate Oak (Quercus robur), Sycamore Maple (Acer pseudoplatanus), Northern Red Oak (Quercus rubra), Honey Locust (Gleditsia triacanthos)
leads.reason: [RESOLVED 2026-09-03, verification pass, moved to blocked: the six/seven register elms all carry the address 'ul. Baluckiego 6' in the city's own wykaz table (girths 200/261/311/220/239/301 cm, GDOS kodinspire .1098/.1101/.1102/.1103/.1104/.1105, designated 1998-11-16; a seventh, .1099, sits 3m from the cluster centre in GDOS but is absent from the wykaz table entirely). Overpass confirms ul. Baluckiego 6 is a hotel/guesthouse building ('U Pana Cogito', a pensjonat i restauracja run from a villa with a garden, per web search). An OSM node right in the middle of the tree coordinates (50.05095, 19.92722) is tagged leisure=garden, access=private, and three adjacent footways (50.0505, 19.9275) carry access=private plus fixme='jest to publicznie dostepne?' (is this publicly accessible?), i.e. OSM's own mappers were unsure and defaulted to private. This fails the access test's first question (can a visitor get in without asking anyone's permission, or talking past a reception/host) the same way a hotel courtyard does: a guest or diner can be in the garden, a passer-by cannot. It also reads as ornamental garden planting (six same-species elms of the same designation batch, one address, one small plot) rather than a grove worth standing in as its own destination, which independently fails the collectible-point/avenue test. The nearby oak, Gleditsia, maple and red-oak entries within 250m sit at two other private addresses (ul. Tyniecka 6/7, ul. Powroziecka 2), same pattern: individual front/back-garden specimens at named house numbers, not street or park trees. No evidence found that any of this pocket is open to the public. Blocked rather than shipped; would reopen only with a source stating the garden or grounds are open to non-guests.

leads.name: Park przy Zawilej cluster (tulip tree, plane, ash)
leads.species: American Tulip Tree (Liriodendron tulipifera), London Plane (Platanus x acerifolia), European Ash (Fraxinus excelsior)
leads.reason: [CHECKED 2026-09-03, verification pass: transit time checked, not cleared.] Confirmed in Kliny/Swoszowice (Nominatim: Sielska street, Kliny, Swoszowice district), about 5.8-6 km south of Rynek Glowny. No leisure=park polygon is mapped at the coordinates in OSM (the ground is tagged forest/grass/farmland along ul. Zawila), so 'Park przy Zawilej' may be informal or unmapped; the three trees themselves are real register entries regardless. On transit: the nearest stop cluster ('Gora Borkowska', ~250-400m from the trees) is served by a long list of route numbers (121,151,175,191,204,214,215,225,235,243,245,254,255,265,275,285,293,475,610,915), and every route checked (155: Podgorze SKA to Swoszowice SKA; 163: Miejskie Centrum Opieki to Szpital Rydygiera; 204: to Czerwone Maki P+R) is a cross-suburban connector to a P+R/rail hub, not a one-seat line from Rynek Glowny or the Old Town. No direct centre-to-Kliny bus or tram line was found. Reaching the centre therefore needs at least one transfer (bus to a hub such as Czerwone Maki P+R, then tram/bus into town), which realistically lands past the ~30 minute day-trip boundary once a transfer wait is counted, though this pass could not get an exact door-to-door minute figure from a journey planner. Per the day-trip rule ('if clearly over 30 minutes, leave it as a lead'), this is left as a lead rather than shipped: the evidence points toward it being too far by transit, even though straight-line distance alone is not disqualifying. A 334cm tulip tree and a 359cm ash would be genuinely distinctive additions if a faster direct route is later found (e.g. a future bus schedule change, or if a nearer tram stop turns out to serve the corridor).
leads.status: unresolved, transit likely exceeds 30 min via transfer; left as lead, not shipped

blocked.name: The Muzeum Archeologiczne Red Beech
blocked.species: Common Beech, purple-leaved form (Fagus sylvatica f. purpurea)
blocked.reason: Dead. Storm-felled 17 February 2022 (Gazeta Krakowska, Nasze Miasto Krakow, RMF24, all reporting the same event); the Wikipedia registry table itself notes 'Drzewo powalone przez wichure 17 lutego 2022'. Popularly said to have been a favourite of Marshal Jozef Pilsudski, unconfirmed. A replacement sapling, the 'Drzewo Poezji' (Tree of Poetry), was planted on the same spot 21 March 2022; too young to qualify as an entry itself.

blocked.name: The Podzamcze Horse Chestnut
blocked.reason: Dead. Storm-felled 10 July 2021 per the Wikipedia registry table's own note ('Drzewo powalone przez burze 10 lipca 2021').
